normal_sequence: open source at Config layer after fast-path miss
open persistent sibling lock file and acquire exclusive lock
for remote source: finish SHA-256 and reject mismatch
rename staging directory to final target
mark guard complete and unlock on drop

failure_behavior.ordinary_population_error: guard best-effort removes staging; target remains unpublished
failure_behavior.population_panic: guard best-effort removes staging during unwind; target remains unpublished
failure_behavior.hard_process_termination_before_rename: destructor cleanup not guaranteed; next managed attempt removes stale staging after acquiring lock
failure_behavior.rename_failure: guard best-effort removes staging; final error returned
failure_behavior.power_loss: durability not established; no explicit fsync/sync_all protocol

completion_model.managed_writer_assumption: Only cooperating writers create the final directory.
